Calum Findley’s

A Cape Breton tune of course. I know it as Calum Finlay’s. (Calum being the Scottish Gaelic for Malcolm)

↳ Posted by bogman on January 13th, 2009.

Calum Fhionnlaith

I know it by the Gaelic name Calum Fhionnlaith. The source for my version is from http://www.capebretonfiddlers.com/images/tunes/Huntington%20Castle_Mill%20of%20Newe%5BSet%5D.pdf and is the tune at the bottom of the second page.

↳ Posted by JACKB on October 27th, 2022.

Malcolm Finlay, X:6

As played by Breaking Trad on their eponymous 2016 album where the tune is called “Shetland reel” because they learned it at “a mighty session at the Shetland Folk Festival some years ago.”
I spoke to Donal Murphy at the Orkney Folk Festival this year and he had, in the interim, become aware of the correct title and provenance of the tune.

↳ Posted by DonaldK on June 10th, 2023.
